unknown: Something went wrong. See the app log for details.

project.folder_unavailable: Could not reserve a new project folder.
project.not_found: This project is no longer in your library.
project.not_recyclable: This project can't be moved to the Recycle Bin.
project.linked_missing: Oleafly can't find the folder {{folder}}. It might have been moved or deleted, or it's on a drive that isn't connected.
project.linked_replaced: The folder {{folder}} isn't the one Oleafly opened before. Open it again to continue.
project.linked_permission_denied: Oleafly doesn't have permission to open the folder {{folder}}.
project.linked_invalid: Oleafly's link to this folder is damaged. Remove it from Oleafly, then open the folder again.
project.linked_not_recyclable: This folder was opened in place, so it can't be moved to the Recycle Bin. Your files are untouched.
project.linked_not_duplicable: This folder was opened in place, so Oleafly can't duplicate it.
project.folder_not_a_folder: Oleafly can't use that location. Choose a folder.
project.folder_in_app_data: Oleafly keeps its own data in that folder. Choose a different one.
project.folder_too_broad: {{name}} is too broad to open as one project. Choose the folder that holds just this project.
project.folder_already_linked: That folder overlaps another project in Oleafly. Choose a different folder.
project.not_linked: Locate works only for folders opened in place.
project.copy_destination_refused: Choose a folder outside the project and outside Oleafly's data folder.
project.copy_nothing_open: No files are open, so there's nothing to save.
project.copy_too_large: The open files are too large to save as a copy.
project.copy_failed: Oleafly couldn't save the copy there. Choose a folder you can write to.
project.folder_picker_failed: Oleafly couldn't open the folder picker. Try again.
project.import_no_main: This import has no LaTeX, Typst or Markdown document to compile.
project.settings_file_exists: This folder already has a project.json, so Oleafly left it as it is.
project.settings_need_main: Choose a main document first, then save the project settings to this folder.
project.settings_write_failed: Oleafly couldn't save the project settings to this folder.

literature.query_too_long: Search query is too long ({{max}} characters maximum).

tex.package_operation_timeout: The package operation passed its {{span}} limit and was stopped, so you can compile again. The TeX Live mirror is probably busy. Try again later, or run tlmgr yourself.
tex.latexmk_build_path: latexmk can't use Oleafly's build folder on this computer because its path contains characters latexmk doesn't accept. Switch this project to Tectonic to compile it.
tex.latexmk_network_folder: latexmk can't compile a folder on a network share. Switch this project to Tectonic, or copy the folder to this computer.

github.sign_in_expired: The sign-in code expired. Try again.

git.remote_exists: This project is already linked to {{remote}}.
git.nested_repository: This project is inside another Git repository, so Oleafly won't create a separate one here.

trust.git: Trust this folder to use Source Control.
trust.repository: Trust the {{name}} repository to use Source Control here.
trust.terminal: Open the terminal yourself to use it in this folder.
trust.agents: Trust this folder to use external agents.
trust.mcp: Trust this folder before MCP clients can use it.
trust.research_tasks: Trust this folder to run research tasks.
trust.run_command: Trust this folder to let the assistant run commands.
trust.full_access: Trust this folder before turning on full access.
trust.system_tex: Trust this folder to compile with latexmk.
trust.shell_escape: Trust this folder before allowing shell escape.
trust.broad_folder: Oleafly can't trust all of {{name}}. Choose a smaller folder.
trust.unavailable: Oleafly couldn't check whether this folder is trusted.

open_folder.not_absolute: Use the full path to the folder.
open_folder.permission_denied: Oleafly doesn't have permission to open this folder.
open_folder.not_a_folder: Choose a folder, not a file.
open_folder.unsupported_folder: Oleafly can't open this type of folder.
open_folder.path_not_unicode: This folder's path contains characters Oleafly can't read. Rename the folder and try again.
open_folder.too_broad: {{name}} holds too much to open as one project. Choose a folder inside it.
open_folder.app_data: This folder is part of Oleafly's app data. Choose a folder outside it.
open_folder.contains_project: This folder contains {{name}}, which is already open in Oleafly as its own project.
open_folder.research_folder: {{project}} can already edit files in this folder through its linked folders. Unlink it there first.

research.linked_project_folder: This folder is open in Oleafly as its own project. Link it as read-only instead.
